prompts.sailing:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: flat merchandise illustration candidate, not a product mockup or logo.
Primary request: create one beautiful, coherent flat SAILING STORY artwork derived from the illustrated sailing scene in the reference Tasar bags and T-shirt. Reference image is a visual style and scene reference only, not an edit target.
Composition: landscape 3:2, a single traditional-looking wooden sailing boat with a laterite terracotta sail crossing rhythmic sea waves, low quiet shoreline and a few palms to the right, small warm sun and two or three simple birds. Human figures minimal and abstract, anatomically coherent, no exaggerated exotic costume. Keep a clear silhouette, elegant woodcut / screen-print inspired linework, large printable shapes and restrained detail so it can adapt to a cup, fabric bag and T-shirt back. The boat stays fully within the canvas with generous clear margin around the illustration. Avoid tiny decorative marks and false historical specificity. This is an imaginative Odisha maritime-remembrance scene, not a reconstruction of a documented vessel or voyage.
Palette: deep sea blue #1D4658, laterite #91462F, warm straw #C1A263 and ivory #F2E6D0. Use solid graphic colours with subtle hand-cut character, no heavy photo texture, no gradients or artificial distress.
Background: genuinely transparent, with clean edges and visible negative space in the water. No paper rectangle, product, fabric, shadow, border, lettering, title, watermark, typography, logo or words. All branding will be placed separately from real outlined type.
Deliver one illustration, not a contact sheet.
prompts.sailing_refinement: Edit target: the supplied sailing illustration. Turn this into a FLAT PRINT-ART candidate, with the same central boat and general composition. Preserve boat, sails, wave shapes, sun and small distant shore. The earlier image has unwanted glow and soft hazes: REMOVE ALL glows, gradients, blurs, soft shadows, vignettes and translucent halos. Hard, crisp graphic boundaries only. Make all areas outside the illustration genuinely fully transparent. Sun is one solid straw disk. Sky between mast, birds, sun and shoreline is fully transparent. Waves are solid deep blue and ivory shapes with transparent gaps. Faces/people remain simple flat silhouettes. Simplify the small shore architecture to low generic shore buildings so it does not claim an identified temple. Use only four flat colours: deep blue #1D4658, terracotta #91462F, straw #C1A263, ivory #F2E6D0. No extra colours or tones. This is a graphic for a fabric print, not a luminous scene. No text, logo, wording, brand, watermark, texture, rectangular background or product mockup. Single landscape 3:2 composition with a clear margin around all visible art.
prompts.range:
Use case: product-mockup. Create one refined catalog concept board for a new Project Odisha merchandise collection, using the five references only for product shapes, warm studio character, book-and-boat emblem and maritime-story styling. CHANGE THE BRAND on every item to the exact English name "PROJECT ODISHA". No UTKAL and no Odia lettering anywhere in this new board.
Layout: clean 2 by 2 editorial grid, generous warm ivory margins, no decorative frames and no headings/captions outside the products. Upper left: a black premium crew-neck T-shirt front and back, shown side by side. Front has the existing book-and-boat symbol and the exact words PROJECT ODISHA in a tasteful stacked serif lockup. Back has the same exact brand above a terracotta sailing-boat story with ivory waves. Upper right: one natural golden Tasar-silk long jhula, a soft portrait pouch with one broad long shoulder strap, cotton-colour lining and a small wooden button, blue PROJECT ODISHA lettering above a blue/laterite sailing illustration. Lower left: an ivory ceramic story mug with sea-blue handle and interior, rotated front and reverse, sea-voyage panorama and prominent exact PROJECT ODISHA lettering on front. Lower right: two premium insulated bottles, matte black and sea blue, wide-mouth carry-loop caps, existing book-and-boat emblem and PROJECT ODISHA beneath it, small wave band near base.
Use the same restrained palette: deep sea blue, warm ivory, laterite, straw. Quiet natural studio light, believable material textures, elegant and wearable rather than oversized souvenir graphics. Precisely readable spelling, PROJECT above ODISHA where useful. No extra slogans, prices, labels, watermarks, invented certifications or claims. These are AI-generated design concepts, not supplier samples.
